environment.description: Same Terraform provider deployed on managed infrastructure. PostgreSQL 15.4 with row-level security policy on tenant_secrets table: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON tenant_secrets USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')). The policy is FORCE-enabled via ALTER TABLE tenant_secrets FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY. The database connection role 'tf_provider_svc' has no BYPASSRLS attribute. Additionally, the tenant_auth table used by the timing-vulnerable auth check also has RLS: CREATE POLICY auth_isolation ON tenant_auth USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')). The pg_hba.conf restricts the tf_provider_svc role to connections only from the provider's pod CIDR (10.244.3.0/24). Note: the SET app.current_tenant statement is issued before every query using the tenant_id from the already-authenticated Terraform workspace identity (OIDC-bound), not from the X-Tenant-ID header in this deployment mode.

rls_policies: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON tenant_secrets USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
CREATE POLICY auth_isolation ON tenant_auth USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
ALTER TABLE tenant_secrets FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE tenant_auth FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
config.tenant_context_source: OIDC workspace identity token (not user-supplied header)
config.network_policy: Calico NetworkPolicy restricting ingress to provider pods from Terraform runner pods only
